introTr: İki hafta daha geçti ve artık deneyimlerinden, planlarından ve kurallardan söz edebiliyorsun. Bu deneme sana nerede güçlendiğini gösterecek. Not için değil, kendini tanımak için çöz.

items.q: Have you ever ___ to New York?
items.whyTr: Present perfect: have/has + V3. Be fiilinin V3'ü 'been'.

items.q: I have never ___ sushi.
items.whyTr: Have never + V3: eat - ate - eaten.

items.q: She has ___ finished the report. It's on your desk.
items.whyTr: Olumlu cümlede 'bitti bile' anlamı için already kullanılır.

items.q: Have you cleaned the classroom ___?
items.whyTr: Soru ve olumsuz cümlede 'henüz' anlamı için yet kullanılır.

items.q: This job is ___ than my old job.
items.whyTr: Good'un karşılaştırması düzensizdir: good - better - best.

items.q: Ms. Carter is the ___ teacher in our school.
items.whyTr: Uzun sıfatlarda en üstünlük: the most + sıfat.

items.q: You look tired. You ___ go to bed early tonight.
items.whyTr: Tavsiye için should + fiil yalın hali kullanılır.

items.q: When I was ten, I ___ swim very well.
items.whyTr: Geçmişte yetenek için could kullanılır.

items.q: At work, we ___ wear a name badge. It's a rule.
items.whyTr: Zorunluluk: have to + fiil. We ile 'have'.

items.q: You ___ bring lunch. The school gives free lunch.
items.whyTr: Gerek yok anlamı için don't have to; mustn't 'yasak' demektir.

items.q: Would you like ___ some tea?
items.whyTr: Would like + to + fiil.

items.q: Do you know where ___?
items.whyTr: Dolaylı soruda düz cümle sırası kullanılır.

items.q: It was raining, ___ we took an umbrella.
items.whyTr: Sonuç bildirmek için so kullanılır.

items.q: Hafsa wants to ___ a substitute teacher.
items.whyTr: Want + to + fiilin yalın hali.

items.q: We are going to visit ___ Statue of Liberty.
items.whyTr: Bilinen, tek olan yer adlarında the kullanılır.

items.q: I need ___ water, please.
items.whyTr: Sayılamayan isimle some kullanılır; many ve a few sayılabilir isimle.

items.q: How ___ sugar do you want in your coffee?
items.whyTr: Sayılamayan isimlerle how much kullanılır.

items.q: The meeting is ___ Thursday ___ 4:00 p.m.
items.whyTr: Günlerle on, saatlerle at kullanılır.

items.q: I'm ___ my manager tomorrow at ten. It's in my calendar.
items.whyTr: Ajandadaki kesin plan için present continuous kullanılır.

items.q: She has worked here ___ 2019.
items.whyTr: Başlangıç noktasıyla (2019) since kullanılır.

items.q: What is the opposite of 'safe'?
items.whyTr: Safe (güvenli) kelimesinin zıttı dangerous (tehlikeli).

items.q: 'Do you have any experience with children?' Experience means:
items.whyTr: Experience, bir işi yaparak kazanılan tecrübedir.

items.q: Which word means the same as 'sick'?
items.whyTr: Sick ve ill aynı anlama gelir.

items.q: I have to ___ the laundry today.
items.whyTr: 'Do the laundry' çamaşır yıkamak demektir.

items.q: What is the opposite of 'full'?
items.whyTr: Full (dolu) kelimesinin zıttı empty (boş).

items.q: 'You should drink plenty of water.' Plenty of means:
items.whyTr: Plenty of, bol miktarda demektir.

items.q: Please ___ a seat. The doctor will see you soon.
items.whyTr: 'Take a seat' oturmak demektir.

items.q: Which word means the same as 'boss'?
items.whyTr: Boss ve manager benzer anlamdadır: patron, yönetici.

items.q: 'The doctor gave me some good advice.' Advice means:
items.whyTr: Advice, yararlı bir tavsiyedir.

items.q: 'The company offers good benefits, like health insurance.' Benefits are:
options: extra things an employee gets besides pay
items.whyTr: Benefits, maaş dışında sağlanan yan haklardır.

items.q: What is the opposite of 'allow'?
items.whyTr: Allow (izin vermek) kelimesinin zıttı forbid (yasaklamak).

items.q: 'Hafsa is nervous before the interview.' Nervous means:
items.whyTr: Nervous, gergin ve endişeli demektir.

passages.title: Practicing for the interview
passages.text:
Hafsa has a job interview tomorrow at Lincoln Elementary. She is nervous, so she is practicing with Emre.

Emre asks, 'Have you ever worked in a school?' Hafsa answers, 'Yes, I have. In Turkey, I taught English to children for two years.' 'Have you ever worked in an American school?' 'No, I haven't. But I have helped at your school many times.' Emre says her answers are good.

Hafsa has already chosen her clothes, and she has just finished ironing her blouse. She hasn't written her questions for the principal yet. She will do that tonight.

Has Hafsa ever worked in an American school?

No, she has never been in a school.

passages.title: Rules for volunteers
passages.text:
Hafsa volunteers in the front office once a week. There are a few rules for volunteers.

Volunteers have to wear a name badge and sign in at the desk every morning. They must not use their phones in front of students. They don't have to wear a uniform, but they should dress neatly.

Mr. Brown says volunteers can take a fifteen-minute break at 10:30. If a parent asks a question about a student, volunteers should call Mr. Brown. They shouldn't share any information about students.

questions.q: What do volunteers have to do every morning?
questions.whyTr: Metinde: 'sign in at the desk every morning'.

questions.q: What don't volunteers have to wear?
questions.whyTr: Metinde: 'They don't have to wear a uniform'.

questions.q: What should a volunteer do when a parent asks about a student?
When can volunteers take a break?

passages.title: Two job offers
passages.text:
Hafsa has two job offers. The first one is at a grocery store. It pays more money, fifteen dollars an hour, and the store is closer to her home. However, she has to work on weekends, and she would be on her feet all day.

The second job is a classroom aide at an elementary school. It pays less, thirteen dollars an hour, and it is farther away. But the hours are better: she finishes at 2:30 and has the same holidays as Emre. It is also the best way to learn about American schools.

Hafsa thinks the aide job is more interesting than the store job, so she is going to accept it.

questions.q: Why does Hafsa choose the aide job?
options: She thinks it is more interesting and has better hours.
It is closer to her home.
She has to work on weekends.
questions.whyTr: Metin: daha ilginç, saatler daha iyi.

questions.q: What is true about the grocery store job?
options: It is closer but she must work on weekends.
questions.whyTr: Metinde mağaza daha yakın ama hafta sonu çalışmak gerekiyor.

script.text: What's the problem, Hafsa?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: I have a bad cough, and I feel tired all the time.

script.speaker: Doctor
script.text: How long have you had the cough?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: For about a week.

script.speaker: Doctor
script.text: I think you should drink a lot of water and get more sleep. You shouldn't go to work for two days.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Can I take some medicine?

script.speaker: Doctor
script.text: Yes, you can take this one twice a day. If you don't feel better in a week, come back.

She cannot sleep because of noise.

writing.promptTr: Bir iş arkadaşına kısa bir mesaj yaz: Hangi işi yapmak istiyorsun ve neden? Daha önce hangi deneyimlerin var? Because, so ve but kullan.
writing.promptEn: Write a short message about the job you would like to do and why. Say what experience you have. Use because, so and but.
checklistTr: Would like to / want to + fiil kullandım mı?
I have worked / I have never ... gibi bir deneyim cümlesi yazdım mı?
Because, so veya but ile en az iki cümleyi birleştirdim mi?
Like/love + -ing ile bir tercih belirttim mi?
Cümleler büyük harfle başlıyor ve nokta ile bitiyor mu?
writing.model: I would like to work in a school because I love working with children. I have taught English in Turkey for two years, but I have never worked in an American school. I have already volunteered at my son's school, so I know some of the rules. I think a school job is more interesting than an office job. I like helping students, and I am very patient.
